Both callbacks stage the per-field BF, counted HBN event entries and the independently paired scene loader144f60/2a0d60, then signal setup completion. Golden folds the constructor into the field-root state machine and changes stored context; work fields/behavior are not declared byte-compatible.

automatic_dungeon_task.proof: Both allocate zeroed work (old72B, Golden128B), return0 on failure, create a priority15 child with dungeon update/destroy callbacks, store supplied stepIndex and entryValue, and clear game flag0xc25. The paired update family requests a missing shared dungeon BF, owns a complete size-based BF copy, starts effect preloads and dispatches the field-root constructor from a16B step-table entry. Expanded state/model setup is explicit, not a behavioral-equivalence claim.

effect_preload_family.guards: Only request the archive when the current step task exists, first preload task slot is null and shared archive handle is null. Request flag1. Missing archive returns ready1; a non-null archive is polled before creating children. Missing current step context follows the recorded assertion/error path, not an invented fallback.

constant_components.meaning_limit: Preserve the observed third constructor parameter; do not infer an unobserved asset/table ID from it.

effect_preload_family.ownership: Each child is parented to the current step task and receives the same shared archive handle. Constructor1bd100 stores that handle at work+8, marks borrowed/archive mode at+14, stores parameter3 at+10 and copies the FULL field/...EPL key at+f0. Do not strip field/ from these member names.
effect_preload_family.finish: Poll all three non-null task slots using1bd530. While any is not ready return0. Once all are ready, release shared archive397cd0 once and clear its global handle; return1. The third P_HAKEN child is a positive Golden addition, not padding or an optional unknown.
effect_preload_family.scope_warning: No three handles may be written into the old two-slot guest array. A Golden-aware provider must own the expanded set and preserve the borrowed archive and parsed effect lifetimes; archive/EPL payload decoding remains a runtime seam.

dungeon_BF_family.proof: Both request field/script/dungeon.bf with flag0 only when the current step context exists and its script buffer is absent. On readiness, allocate an owned buffer from full request size, copy all file bytes, store pointer+size together, release the request and clear its transient handle. Golden merges request/copy into update states1 and10; fields widen and offsets differ.
dungeon_BF_family.runtime_limit: Source-key/ownership proof only, not proof that the Golden BF payload is byte-identical to PS2 or that native VM support is complete.
